description:
2026-07-21 adversarial UAT review finding (P2): stream success is computed then dropped. TPCHThroughputTest sets result.success from min_success_rate (throughput_test.py:214-218) but _execute_tpch_throughput_test only PRINTS it (execution.py:473-477); _create_throughput_phase copies streams + metric only (result_capture.py:1553-1576). TPCHThroughputTest.validate_results (throughput_test.py:616-635) - the only code checking streams_successful == num_streams and 22-queries-per-stream - has ZERO callers (dead code).

Consequence: a stream that dies before its first query (connection_factory throws, throughput_test.py:444, caught at :594-596) exports zero queries[] rows, while compute_metrics multiplies the REQUESTED num_streams over the survivors' TTT (runner.py:361-374) -> plain `benchbox run`/`run-official` outside the UAT harness publishes a valid-looking result from an invalid run. The nightly UAT lane does catch it (tests/uat/runner.py:262-278 + nightly.yml assert step) - the product path must too.

Also in scope: run.streams derived as max(stream_id) (off-by-one; schema.py::_build_run_section, cited at tests/uat/throughput.py:152-156), and the accidental-but-load-bearing stream-0 validation invariant: set_query_context called WITHOUT stream_id (throughput_test.py:505-506) is the only reason validation runs on streams >0 at all, because registry.get_expected_result returns None for stream_id>0 (registry.py:89-99). Pin it with a comment + test before anyone 'fixes' it into silently disabling validation.

anti_patterns.dont: enforce partial-stream fatality only in the UAT lane
anti_patterns.instead: enforce at the runner/export seam so every consumer inherits it
anti_patterns.why: plain benchbox run-official can publish an invalid throughput result today; the defect is in the product path

anti_patterns.dont: exclude failed streams from S and still emit a metric
anti_patterns.instead: any failed/dead stream fails the throughput phase; no metric
anti_patterns.why: that understates offered load and launders a failed measurement into a result

anti_patterns.dont: pass stream_id to set_query_context without registry support
anti_patterns.instead: pin current behavior with a test first; change only together with per-stream expected-results support
anti_patterns.why: registry.get_expected_result returns None for stream_id>0, which would silently disable validation on streams 1..N-1
